events.summary: Hey, everyone! events.title: Demo Update 1.0.4
events.summary: Hi, everyone!Today I'm releasing another update:- Added support for Spanish and Portuguese (Brazilian)- Fixed interactions with colliders in various locations (the "Shark" anomaly, doorways, NPC colliders)- Improved interactions with doors- Updated the content of the “Credits” tab- Minor visual tweaksSpecial thanks to prietonn for the high-quality Spanish translation!Thanks to all of you and have a nice Sunday! - Denis

Added languages: - German - TurkishThe rules board texture has been localized.Lighting in some areas has been improved.Interaction with the Jungle anomaly has been updated. events.title: Demo release
events.summary: Hi, everyone! Today I’m finally releasing the demo version of the first act of “True Nightmare - Diner Loop” to the public. While maintaining the atmosphere of the first part, I wanted to try combining it with the popular “loop” genre. I hope it turned out interesting. Over the weekend, I’ll add support for Turkish and German (numbers 3 and 4 on the wish list). If you have any language requests, let me know and I’ll try to add that one too. events.title: Demo release soon!
events.summary: Hi everyone, it's Denis here!After some time of waiting, I’d like to announce the upcoming release of the demo version! Unlike the first part, where the demo served as a prologue, this time it will be a portion of the game’s opening.Just like with the first part, there will be a beta test open to anyone who wants to participate.I’ll share more details within the week.Thanks to everyone for your support - see you very soon!In the meantime, add the game to your Wishlists and follow me on social me
